outcome: Cord blood glucose levels at delivery
Newborn glucose levels at 2 hours after delivery
cohort: Term newborns born at Khartoum Hospital, Sudan
finding: Cord blood glucose levels were significantly lower in cesarean-delivered neonates than vaginally-delivered neonates.
mod_finding: Cord blood glucose levels were significantly lower in cesarean-delivered neonates than vaginally-delivered neonates.
